# HR portal

## Requirements

- Managers must complete harassment training every year, under the Workplace Code.
- Employees must be able to see everything held about them, per the Data Rights Policy.
- Leave records must be kept for six years under the Employment Records Act.

## Stories

- As a manager, I want a yearly harassment training course assigned to me so that I stay within the code.
- As an HR officer, I want leave records retained for six years so that the legal period is met.
- As an employee, I want to see all the information the company holds about me so that I can check it.
